name: ast-grep

storage.rationale: This tool has no tool-owned persistent storage in the supported Vrooli workflow; the explicit empty declaration records that caches or credentials are owned by the invoking workflow.

description: Structural code search and lint tool using AST patterns
installHint: Install ast-grep from GitHub releases: https://github.com/ast-grep/ast-grep/releases — or via cargo install ast-grep, or npm install -g @ast-grep/cli
